title: Velocity and Acceleration in Polar Coordinates
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Polar Unit Vectors
definitions.statement: In polar coordinates, u_r is the radial unit vector pointing away from the origin along the ray theta, and u_theta is the transverse unit vector pointing in the direction of increasing theta. They form a right-handed orthonormal basis.
definitions.explanation: Their derivatives satisfy d u_r / d theta = u_theta and d u_theta / d theta = -u_r.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Basis vectors rotate with the position of the particle.

definitions.title: Velocity and Acceleration in Polar Coordinates
definitions.statement: Decomposes velocity and acceleration into radial and transverse components. The term 2 dot{r} dot{theta} is the Coriolis acceleration.
conditions: r(t) and theta(t) are twice differentiable
definitions.explanation: Under a central force field (a_theta = 0), angular momentum r^2 dot{theta} = h is conserved, proving Kepler's Second Law of equal areas in equal times.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Radial acceleration includes centripetal term -r dot{theta}^2, while transverse acceleration contains Coriolis coupling.
